review.note: Title from the article (A12 (5)), which disambiguates the 2024 battle from the 2012 one; the item's label does not. Place by A9's second step (P276 Q2312553, the village of Tinzaouaten): the item's own P625 is 28 km west of it, which is the "outskirts of Tinzaouaten" the article itself names. Of the four participants the item's P710 gives — Mali, JNIM, the Wagner Group and the CSP — only Mali is an actor this atlas holds, so only Mali is on the record (A12 (4)).

title: Battle of Tinzaouaten (2024)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Tinzaouaten (2024)", at revision 1373950868, opens: "The battle of Tinzaouaten was a battle between the rebel coalition Strategic Framework for the Defense of the People of Azawad (CSP-DPA), and the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) backed by the Wagner Group, a Russian state-funded mercenary group. It took place in the outskirts of Tinzaouaten, a commune near the Algeria–Mali border." Wikidata item Q128007033, whose own description reads "2024 battle". That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does.

actors.note: P710 on Q128007033; the article makes the Malian Armed Forces one of the two sides.
